text:
Anya K: Hey team — quick idea for the next webinar: 'Benchmarks That Move Buyers: Translating latency & cost tradeoffs into purchasing decisions.' Pitch: practical playbook for platform and infra leads so they can justify infra spend. Quick thoughts?
Chris L: Love the angle. More useful than pure benchmarks — tie to procurement/ROI.
Marta: +1. Could structure around three customer archetypes (startup, scale, enterprise) and show recommended configs / expected $/qps.
Kyle: We should avoid heavy model details; focus on outcomes and ops tradeoffs. Maybe a short live demo showing perf vs cost when we switch batching/quantization.
Sophie: Can volunteer to moderate and run Q&A. Also can coordinate case-study ask to 2 customers (if they can present 5–7 min each).
Anya K: Draft abstract: "Buy vs Build: A pragmatic framework to compare latency, cost, & reliability for production LLM features. We demonstrate concrete knobs (batching, cache, quantization), show unit-econ math, and a short live simulation of real traffic." Thoughts?
Marta: Nice—shorten to 2 lines for registration copy. For speaker lineup: Product (Anya), Runtime eng (Chris), Customer (TBD). Ask @eng-sre for a signal on safe demo workload.
Chris L: I'll sync with eng-runtime on Tuesday. Need a canned dataset and guardrails. Also suggest recording a fallback clip in case live demo flaps.
Kyle: Rehearsal request: block 60m for run-through + 30m tech check. Prefer Wed 3/18 or Thu 3/19 PST.
Sophie: Calendar poll created: https://cal.link/benchmarks-webinar — please vote by EOD Friday.
marketing-bot: New event draft created in Google Calendar by Sophie: "Benchmarks That Move Buyers" (tentative).
Marta: Draft run-of-show (30–45m total):
- 0:00–0:05 intro & outcomes (Sophie)
- 0:05–0:18 product framing + buyer narratives (Anya)
- 0:18–0:30 technical deep dive (Chris)
- 0:30–0:38 live simulation + fallback clip (Chris)
- 0:38–0:45 customer case & closing (Customer + Sophie)
- 0:45–0:50 rapid-fire Q&A (All)
Anya K: Looks good. Need CTA: 1) checklist download (one-pager cost calc), 2) sign up for Dedicated trial.
Kyle: For the checklist we should include a quick command snippet engineers can run to sample token cost: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/infer -d '{"prompt":"...","max_tokens":100}'` with notes on batching.
Sophie: I'll draft landing page headline/short form and a 2-sentence speaker blurb.
Marta: Marketing asks: can we get two short benchmark charts (latency vs tokens/sec and cost per 1k tokens) by Tue so creative can do CTAs? Chris/Kyle?
Chris L: We'll produce charts — can mock numbers if needed for design, will finalize by Tue EOD.
Anya K: Action items: Chris -> charts + demo guardrails; Sophie -> landing copy + poll; Marta -> one-pager checklist; Kyle -> sample curl snippet + fallback clip; All -> vote on poll.
Kyle: Noted. Also flagging legal for any customer names in slides.
Sophie: I'll ping legal & customer success.
Marta: Rehearsal schedule will be posted after poll closes. If anyone can't make the main rehearsal, please record a 3–4 min backup clip of your section.
Anya K: Thanks team — excited. Small ask: keep messaging buyer-focused (ops, SRE, platform managers) not just ML folks. :rocket:
Chris L: :thumbsup:
Sophie: Will do.
